definitions.explanation: The cooking process of removing bitter, astringent, or harsh components from vegetables and other ingredients to improve their taste.

examples.japanese: ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{灰汁|あく}{抜|ぬ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Remove the bitterness from spinach before using it.

examples.japanese: ⟦たけのこ→筍：17667_takenoko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{灰汁|あく}{抜|ぬ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦ぬか→糠：29202_nuka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Use rice bran to remove the harshness from bamboo shoots.

examples.japanese: {灰汁|あく}{抜|ぬ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{怠|おこた}る→怠る：03936_okotaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{苦味|にがみ}→苦味：14101_nigami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: If you skip removing the bitterness, the bitter taste will remain.

notes:
FORMATION: ⟦{灰汁|あく}→灰汁：13457_aku⟧ (lye; harsh/bitter components) + {抜|ぬ}き (removing).

COOKING TECHNIQUE: Essential preparation step in Japanese cuisine for many vegetables.

COMMON METHODS:
- ⟦{茹|ゆ}でて→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧⟦{灰汁|あく}→灰汁：13457_aku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (boil and skim off scum)
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{晒|さら}す→晒す：04609_sarasu⟧ (soak in water)
- ⟦{塩水|しおみず}→塩水：12119_shiomizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漬|つ}ける→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧ (soak in salt water)
- ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦ぬか→糠：29202_nuka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧ (boil with rice bran)

COMMON INGREDIENTS REQUIRING {灰汁|あく}{抜|ぬ}き:
- ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧ (spinach)
- ⟦たけのこ→筍：17667_takenoko⟧ (bamboo shoots)
- ⟦{蕨|わらび}→蕨：noentry⟧ (bracken fern)
- ⟦ごぼう→牛蒡：13484_gobou⟧ (burdock root)
